text:
Priyanka: hey team, first day here — trying to open the model-serving Grafana dashboard but I get a 403. URL: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/gh3-model-serve. anyone know the usual flow to get access?
DevX-Bot: Welcome Priyanka! Please complete the Observability access form: https://go/redwood/obs-access. That typically triggers Okta -> Grafana mapping.
Priyanka: I filled the obs ticket (req #12456) and included Grafana: gh3-model-serve, Datadog: model-prod, Sentry: model-service-prod. still 403 after an okta sign-in.
Samir: welcome! :tada: usually either Okta group mapping hasn't synced or the dashboard sits in a restricted folder. Can you open devtools and paste the /api/dashboards/uid response error id?
Priyanka: network response: {"message":"user not authorized for dashboard","errorId":"graf-0b7c"}.
Samir: that screams folder-level restriction. Tagging eng-observability to help — @Samir here can temporarily give you folder-view for 24h while we sort mapping.
Priyanka: that would be great, I need to check p99 latency after a deploy.
ops-bot: Granted temporary folder-view to priyanka@redwood.com for uid gh3-model-serve (expires in 24h). Note: edit perms still require dashboard owner approval.
Priyanka: can see the panels now, thanks! one more Q: Datadog still shows "invite pending". should I accept the invite email or wait for the obs ticket to close?
Samir: accept the Datadog invite email. We usually add everyone to staging first. If monitors are missing after acceptance, ping here and include the invite id.
Priyanka: accepted Datadog invite and can view staging monitors. Sentry project still not visible but obs ticket says "pending identity mapping".
Samir: that matches the usual flow. If the obs ticket stalls >24h ping this thread and I'll escalate. Also FYI if you want to propose dashboard tweaks, fork the dashboard and submit a PR to the dashboards repo; owners review.
Priyanka: perfect, thanks everyone! excited to dig in :rocket:
thread_text_short: New hire Priyanka hits Grafana 403; fills obs-access; temporary folder-view granted; Datadog invite accepted; Sentry pending identity mapping.
